> [@csfreak92](https://github.com/csfreak92) please could you add some section and chapter text to this section as you see necessary.
> 
> A few important points:
> 
> * We are hoping to finished within the next couple of weeks, if you don't think you will have time in this timeframe, please say so and then [@jmanico](https://github.com/jmanico) can take it on.
> * Please try and keep it as short and specific as possible. It should be limited to a simple explanation of the section and any critical information which someone trying to understand the requirements would need.
> * As noted in [V5 chapter texts - move input validation parts to correct place #2580](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/2580), please refer to the text from V5 if necessary for the relevant moved requirements.
> * Requirement 11.1.9 does attempt to immediately define "atomic transactions". i.e. either all succeeds or all fails, but if you want to open a separate issue where you suggest a refinement to the wording, feel free.

Josh, I took at stab at this that is minimal and used only a little text from V5. Once the move is done, I'll take a look at the final list of requirements and use more of the older text so it's not lost.
